notes: Stories refined for clearer separation of continue vs retry semantics and stricter idempotency guarantees.

change_log.value: Render timeout modal with explicit actions: continue waiting (preserve in-flight request, no new call) and abandon (cancel via AbortController). Clarify that no retry is triggered from this modal; retry is a separate user action.
change_log.note: Clarify UX contract to prevent duplicate request ambiguity

change_log.value: Integrate timeout handling across full chat lifecycle ensuring strict idempotency: exactly one active request, no duplicate backend calls across continue/abandon flows, and safe state recovery after cancellation or late responses.

stories.title: Timeout UX Contract and State Schema
stories.description: Define and normalize frontend state schema for timeout handling including states (pending, timed_out, continued, abandoned), timer threshold (45s), retry intent flag, and modal visibility. Ensure compatibility with existing ChatWindow state and AbortController lifecycle.

stories.title: Core Timeout Detection and Control Logic
stories.description: Implement 45-second timeout detection with safe cleanup, ensuring timers are cleared on response, cancel, or retry. Prevent duplicate in-flight requests and enforce single active request using AbortController.

stories.title: Timeout Modal UI (Continue / Abandon)
stories.description: Render timeout modal with explicit actions: continue waiting (preserve in-flight request, no new call) and abandon (cancel via AbortController). Clarify that no retry is triggered from this modal; retry is a separate user action.

stories.title: Timeout Handling Test Coverage
stories.description: Add unit and component tests validating timeout trigger, modal rendering, continue (no duplicate request), and abandon (AbortController invoked). Include edge cases for rapid responses, late responses after timeout, and repeated retries.
stories.evidence: GAP: No existing frontend test coverage for ChatWindow timeout behavior; requires new tests

stories.title: End-to-End Integration with Chat Request Lifecycle
stories.description: Integrate timeout handling across full chat lifecycle ensuring strict idempotency: exactly one active request, no duplicate backend calls across continue/abandon flows, and safe state recovery after cancellation or late responses.
